name: traccia
description: Local screen recording, conversation transcription and dictation for macOS. Turn screen and audio into files AI agents can read, or speech into text in your apps.
author: Francesco Sganga

scripts.build: electron-vite build && npm run build:native && npm run build:cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && npm run typecheck -w packages/cli
scripts.link: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir --$(uname -m | sed s/x86_64/x64/) --config electron-builder.yml -c.mac.timestamp=none -c.mac.signIgnore='\.pak$' && node scripts/link-app.cjs
